modules.title: Asking for and giving personal information
Describing destinations and managing visitor services
Giving information about places of interest and weather conditions
Fundamental pillars of the training program

lessons.title: Nationalities and languages
lessons.description: Say where people are from and what languages they speak.

lessons.title: Talking about schedules
lessons.description: Say and ask the time, and talk about daily schedules.

lessons.title: Asking for and giving personal information
lessons.description: Ask for and give names, ages, numbers and contact details.

lessons.title: Food and drinks
lessons.description: Order food and drinks and ask about prices.

lessons.title: Means of transportation
lessons.description: Talk about how to get to places.

lessons.title: Where you and other people are from
lessons.description: Describe where you and other people are from.

lessons.title: Animals and plants of the region
lessons.description: Name common animals and plants found in the region.

lessons.title: Directions to tourist places
lessons.description: Ask for and give directions to places and attractions.

lessons.title: Free time and leisure activities
lessons.description: Talk about free time and leisure.

lessons.title: Health problems and symptoms
lessons.description: Say what is wrong and describe simple symptoms.

lessons.title: Sustainable tourism (green communication)
lessons.description: Recycling bins, basic conservation instructions, colours and green signs.

lessons.title: Tourism as a culture for peace (intercultural mediation)
lessons.description: Welcome international guests with courtesy; greetings from around the world.

lessons.title: Tourism culture (service and storytelling)
lessons.description: Give simple directions to landmarks or hotel facilities; places in the city and telling the time.
